rules: Candidate-only source observations; canonical dates, status, publication and whole-record freshness unchanged.
Unknown and blocked do not establish availability; no date is rolled to a new year. Failed paths enter cooldown.
Closed dates bind only the exact matched year, programme and funding route. No programme discontinuation is inferred.
Independent awards do not borrow admission deadlines; only explicit concurrent scholarship forms bind the stated route.
SZTU successor2027 remains separate from stored2026-2027 rows; stale July2026 process wording is disclosed. No open status is asserted.
SCFAI retained web-observation excerpts are not original server bytes or offline-original certification. Doctoral and bachelor cycles remain blocked.
Month precision and relative openings do not become invented exact dates.
